title: Sell Mineral Rights in Artesia, NM
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Artesia, NM | Royalty Buyer
metaDescription: Artesia sits in the middle of Eddy County's busiest Delaware Basin drilling corridor. Get a straight cash offer from a former E&P operations engineer.
heroLead: Artesia has always been an oil town first, dating back to strikes decades before the current shale boom, and it still functions that way today.
intro: Artesia sits inside the corridor between here and Carlsbad that's carried some of the densest horizontal Bone Spring and Wolfcamp development in the entire Delaware Basin over the past several years. If you own minerals or royalty on acreage in or around Artesia, you're in one of the more actively drilled pockets of New Mexico, and that history is worth understanding before you consider an offer.

sections.heading: A refining town sitting on active acreage
paragraphs: Artesia is known for its refinery as much as for drilling, but the acreage surrounding town has seen consistent horizontal development from major operators working the Carlsbad-Artesia corridor. That ongoing activity supports both current production value and, for undeveloped tracts, real near-term drilling potential.

sections.heading: New Mexico specifics that affect your offer
paragraphs: Some acreage around Artesia sits under state trust or federal BLM land rather than purely private surface, which affects permitting pace and sometimes royalty terms. I ask about surface ownership early so your valuation reflects the actual situation rather than a generic assumption.

sections.heading: Getting a real number
paragraphs: A division order or recent check stub is the fastest path to an honest range, since it tells me the operator and your decimal interest directly. For undeveloped acreage, I lean on nearby permitting trends given how active this corridor has been.

sections.heading: What closing looks like from Artesia
paragraphs: Most of my Artesia sellers aren't local to New Mexico at all, and the process doesn't require you to be. I send a purchase and sale agreement, confirm your title against county and state records, and close by mail or courier, usually within three to six weeks of a signed agreement assuming there's no probate to untangle.

faqs.question: Is Artesia still seeing new drilling activity?
faqs.answer: Yes, the corridor between Artesia and Carlsbad remains one of the more actively developed parts of the Delaware Basin, with multiple operators running ongoing pad programs.

faqs.question: Does state or federal land ownership near Artesia change my offer?
faqs.answer: It can affect permitting timing and occasionally royalty terms, so I factor it in once I know how your specific tract is situated.

faqs.question: I live out of state, can I still sell my Artesia interest?
faqs.answer: Yes, most of my New Mexico sellers aren't local. Closing happens by mail or courier and I handle the New Mexico-specific title requirements.
